subject: Tiered commission bands & listing credit proposal — action items
messages:
From: Akira Tanaka <akira@cloudchannel.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Initial proposal — tiered commission bands + listing credits

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the time this morning. As discussed, attached is our v2 offer that aligns listing-credit mechanics with a tiered commission band:

- Band A (>$250k ARR): 12% listing credit + 3% rebate on committed marketplace spend
- Band B ($100k–$250k ARR): 8% listing credit + 2% rebate
- Band C (<$100k ARR): 4% listing credit, no rebate

Key operational asks: we need a 45-day SLA on reporting (to calculate credits), a single-line item on invoices for credit reconciliation, and a one-year term with automatic renewal unless either party gives 60 days notice.

I attached the commission schedule and a redlined clause for invoice treatment. Happy to jump on a follow-up with procurement/finance next week.

Best,
Akira Tanaka
Head of Channel Partnerships
CloudChannel Inc.
[attachment: CC_offer_v2.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Akira Tanaka <akira@cloudchannel.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial proposal — tiered commission bands + listing credits

Thanks Akira — appreciate the clear breakdown. I looped in Karthik (sales ops), Laura (finance), and Soojin (partner programs) so we can validate the mechanics and accounting treatment.

A few immediate asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether listing credits are applied at invoice issuance or as a quarterly reconciliation?
- Will the reporting export include invoice-level pointers for each eligible booking (invoice id, region, marketplace SKU)?
- We prefer a 30-day reporting SLA if possible; 45 days is workable but delays complicate our close.

Proposed next step: internal alignment (this thread) then a short call Wed 8/11 to finalize operational items before legal reviews.

Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
[inline: commission_schedule.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial proposal — tiered commission bands + listing credits

Forwarding Akira's note — my quick read below for finance/ops: 

- Listing credits as a line item: good for transparency. We need to ensure credits are contra-revenue in our GL (so revenue recognition isn't overstated). Laura, can we map the suggested bands to ledger treatment?
- Reporting SLA: 30 days is much easier for our forecasting cadence; 45 days will create mismatches.
- Term & auto-renewal: procurement prefers 1-year with 30-day opt-out for Redwood (but we may accept 60 days if partner insists).

If finance signs off, I'll ask Akira for a redline that legal can start reviewing.

-Karthik
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Akira Tanaka <akira@cloudchannel.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@aws-partner.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial proposal — tiered commission bands + listing credits

Hi team — quick update after internal review:

- We can move the reporting SLA to 30 days and will include invoice-level pointers (invoice id, SKU, region).
- We updated the contract to show credits applied at invoice issuance with a quarterly reconciliation clause (see attached PDF).
- Offer includes a one-year term with a 60-day notice for renewal by default; we can consider a 30-day notice if Redwood takes a 24-month commitment.

Attached: CC_offer_v2.pdf (redline), commission_schedule.xlsx.

Jordan from AWS checked on marketplace nuances — he confirmed AWS requires the credit mechanics be visible on the invoice for marketplace reconciliation, so the single-line item request is consistent with their ops requirements.

Let me know if you want this in DocuSign-ready form.

Best,
Akira
[attachment: CC_offer_v2.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Akira Tanaka <akira@cloudchannel.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial proposal — tiered commission bands + listing credits — agreed next steps

Team — thanks, everyone. Quick summary and action items so we can move to legal/procurement: 

1) Reporting & credits: Akira agreed to 30-day reporting and invoice-line application with quarterly reconciliation. Action: Akira to send final DocuSign bundle by 8/14.
2) Accounting treatment: Laura to confirm GL mapping; if contra-revenue treatment is needed, finance will provide the journal template by 8/16.
3) Term/notice: partner holds to 60-day default; we will propose 24-month commit in exchange for 30-day notice. Action: Karthik to collect revenue sensitivity and propose commit level by 8/13.
4) Legal/Procurement: I'll attach the offer to a procurement ticket and request redline. Marcus — please coordinate with Legal on expedited review.

If all good, I'll authorize Laura to accept the DocuSign once legal clears the redline.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
